verdict.rationale: Zep's Context Graph automatically ingests raw messages via thread.add_messages and extracts entities/facts/edges into the knowledge graph, with incremental thread summaries generated and updated in the background, and community evidence confirms Zep evolved its extraction/consolidation pipeline (Graphiti) specifically to improve automatic fact extraction/reconciliation over naive LLM extraction. This shows the memory layer autonomously decides what's salient and consolidates it without explicit user tagging. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark or hands-on evidence quantifying extraction accuracy/recall quality, and no detail on exactly what heuristics determine 'salience' beyond entity/edge extraction.
